manifesto.quoteStart: “Cheating on your tasks is only cheating yourself:
manifesto.quoteHighlight: here, every coin and every level carries the weight of your sincerity.
manifesto.description: You are the one who stocks the reward shop. Gold is earned through your own sweat, and rewards are enjoyed by you in real life. faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your first quest.

founderPromo.question: How does the 'Founding Members' launch promotion work?
founderPromo.answer: The Founding Members promotion is a limited edition exclusive to the first 30 HabitParty subscribers. By claiming your spot, you unlock the Annual plan with roughly 45% off ($10.90 instead of $19.90) and receive the exclusive, lifetime 'Founding Member' badge engraved on your profile. This badge is permanent: it stays on your profile forever, even if you choose not to renew after 1 year.

freeVsPremium.question: Is HabitParty free? What does the Premium plan offer?
freeVsPremium.answer: HabitParty has a 100% free plan with everything you need: up to 2 independent workspaces, 4 columns per workspace, 4 Focus Mode activities, up to 25 rewards, a 20-item backpack, and up to 5 active email reminders simultaneously (with 20 monthly sends) for your to-dos. For those managing multiple projects and seeking deep focus, the Cosmic Guardian plan brings expanded email reminders (up to 30 active & 100 monthly sends), animated profile frames, ambient sound generators (Rain, Cafe, Lofi, Campfire), VIP icon packs, expansion to 4 workspaces, 6 columns, 6 focus activities, up to 100 rewards, and a 100-item backpack.

honestyShop.question: How does the Shop work and why is it based on honesty?
honestyShop.answer: You stock the reward shop with your own real-life treats (e.g., watching a movie, ordering pizza, 1 hour of gaming). HabitParty is a game of sincerity: you can't cheat yourself. If you check off tasks you didn't actually complete, the reward loses all its meaning. When you play fair, every achievement brings genuine, guilt-free satisfaction.

hardcoreMode.question: What is Hardcore Mode?
hardcoreMode.answer: Hardcore Mode can be enabled for To-dos, Habits, and Dailies. If you fail your daily commitment or let a task's deadline expire, the game deducts gold coins from your balance and reduces your XP at midnight. Additionally, overdue tasks have their due date locked and late rewards reduced, creating a real consequence that strengthens your discipline.

partyGuild.question: Is the Party / Guild system with friends available yet?
partyGuild.answer: Currently, you can use HabitParty with full solo focus. The team Guild and Party system is in its final stages of development and will launch soon so you can level up alongside friends in the same workspace.

dataPreservation.question: What happens to my columns and data if Premium expires?
dataPreservation.answer: No data or task is ever deleted! At HabitParty we guarantee zero data loss. If you created up to 6 columns or 4 workspaces during Premium and return to the Free plan, everything remains 100% preserved. The board displays up to 4 active columns simultaneously while extra columns stay safely stored and can be swapped via the column manager anytime. Additional workspaces enter a safe read-only mode. Plus, you receive advance notices in the sidebar (7, 3, and 1 day before) so you can renew with peace of mind.

experienceMode.question: Is HabitParty just a game or is it suitable for serious work and studies?
experienceMode.answer: HabitParty blends serious productivity and smart gamification into two styles you can switch anytime with 1 click in Settings: 'Essential Mode' delivers a clean executive interface with a Credits & Points economy, Strict Deadlines, and Inventory Management; while 'Adventure Mode' brings the full gamified experience with gold coins, lifetime XP, Mystery Boxes, Hardcore Mode, and victory sound effects. All your tasks, boards, and history are 100% preserved in both modes.

mobileApp.question: Does it work well on mobile? Will there be a Mobile App?
mobileApp.answer: Yes! Today the HabitParty web app features a 100% responsive design for any smartphone, tablet, or computer. Furthermore, the native iOS and Android app (with widgets and push notifications) is already mapped on our Roadmap starting in version 2.0.
